not_found.message: Permission preset 'checkout-gates' not found at project scope.
not_found._note: Shown in ship-permissions-detail after Get returns NOT_FOUND. The detail panel renders the error inline; the list re-fetches and the stale row is cleared.

already_exists.message: A preset named 'ship-standard' already exists at project scope. Use Put to replace it, or choose a different id.
already_exists._note: Field-level validation message — rendered inline below the id input in ship-permissions-editor. Editor keeps the draft so the operator can correct the id and retry.

bad_id.message: Invalid preset id '_admin': ids may not begin with an underscore.
bad_id._note: Inline field error on the id input. Fired on blur before the Create RPC is called. ship-permissions-editor blocks submission until the id is corrected.

parse_error.message: Preset body is not valid JSON. Check the tools object and retry.
parse_error._note: Rare path — triggered when the editor emits malformed JSON (e.g., pasted raw TOML). The built-in JSON validator should surface this before the RPC is sent.
